title: surge.dem omits the spec-pinned mid-run fix + Crisis_Resolved sequence — resolve lifecycle has no E2E/golden pin
evidence:
spec-4-2-surge-crisis.md:33 — "- **Golden:** NEW `demos/surge.dem` (unprepared narrow-pipe fan: trigger @window start, a mid-run capacity fix, resolve after the window ends); the event-stream golden pins `Crisis_Triggered{Surge}` at the exact tick within the scheduled window."
spec-4-2-surge-crisis.md:141 — "a parallel wide drawn mid-run pools into the same bundle (the fix); the queue drains after the window ends (base demand 2/tick ≤ 2.67 service) → `Crisis_Resolved` at the exact drain tick — read from the run, pinned in the demo comment + tests."
demos/surge.dem:10-12 — "The crisis stays ACTIVE through the window / AND beyond (base demand keeps the bottleneck saturated — the player never / fixed it; the banner + red bottleneck outline persist: honest)."
demos/surge.dem:21-23 — "at 100ms draw 0 1 narrow / at 100ms draw 1 2 narrow / capture at 30000ms"
detail: The frozen spec's golden bullet and design notes promise the demo pins the resolve lifecycle (mid-run fix, Crisis_Resolved at the drain tick). The shipped demo draws no fix and never resolves — resolve/re-trigger coverage is unit-only, and the deviation is not in the spec changelog.
recommended_fix: Either add the fix + resolve sequence to surge.dem (new captures, re-bless) or amend the spec Golden bullet + changelog documenting the deliberate no-fix demo.
